requirements.title: Conformance suite harness
requirements.rationale: The three providers must look the same to the agent loop, and that must be proven offline on every change through the same path an embedder takes.

criteria.action: keep every line of code, the httptest servers included, in _test.go files, with doc.go holding only the package doc comment
criteria.contract: no non-test file of the root module gains a listening API call, and no package imports internal/providerconformance, so the root line budget is unchanged

setup: the repository tree with internal/providerconformance/ present
check.pseudocode: files = glob('internal/providerconformance/*.go'); nonTest = [f for f in files if !f.endsWith('_test.go')]; assert nonTest == ['doc.go']; ast = parse(doc.go); assert len(ast.Decls)==0 and ast.Doc != nil; assert no importer of the package

criteria.condition: go test ./internal/providerconformance runs, with or without -short
criteria.action: run each of the cases text, tool_call, tool_call_stop, thinking, cut_off, error_status and error_in_stream against each of anthropic, openrouter and ollama as 21 independent, parallel-safe subtests named <provider>/<case>
criteria.contract: 21 subtests whose paths end in /<provider>/<case>; -run 'TestProviderConformance.*/ollama/thinking' selects exactly one subtest; the suite does not skip under -short and so runs in make check

setup: go toolchain available to a test subprocess
the three vendor fakes compiled into the test binary
check.pseudocode: out = exec('go test -short -v -json ...'); passes = subtests with action pass; assert len(passes)==21; assert no skip; out2 = exec(... -run pattern); assert [s for s in subtests(out2)] == ['TestProviderConformance/ollama/thinking']

criteria.action: build each subtest's agent with agentkit.New using Provider set to the provider name, Model "STANDARD", a toolset of one internal/testkit.EchoTool named echo, MaxTurns 4, and a map-backed Getenv holding only that provider's variables (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OPENROUTER_BASE_URL set to <server>/api/v1, or OLLAMA_HOST) pointed at that subtest's own fake
criteria.contract: agentkit.New received Provider equal to the provider name, Model "STANDARD", MaxTurns 4 and one tool named echo; the Getenv map holds only ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, or OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OPENROUTER_BASE_URL (ending /api/v1), or OLLAMA_HOST; every variable requested by the provider resolves to that subtest's own fake address; the fake records at least one request

setup: a fake per subtest
a recording Getenv wrapper around the map-backed function
check.pseudocode: env = fakeEnv(provider, fake.URL); assert keys(env) subset of providerVars[provider]; agent = agentkit.New(Config{Provider:p, Model:'STANDARD', Getenv: lookup(env), Toolset: [echo], MaxTurns:4}); run; assert len(fake.requests) >= 1

criteria.action: never read the process environment and never connect to any address other than its loopback fakes
criteria.contract: every subtest has the same outcome when ANTHROPIC_*, OPENROUTER_* or OLLAMA_HOST are exported in the process environment with other values

setup: a decoy loopback listener that counts connections
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_BASE_URL and OLLAMA_HOST exported to values pointing at the decoy
check.pseudocode: decoy = listen('127.0.0.1:0'); env = os.Environ + decoy-pointing vars; r = exec(go test -short -json, env); assert pass==21; assert decoy.accepted == 0

criteria.action: take every expected model id and effort from catalog.Select(provider, "STANDARD", "") and contain no literal model id
criteria.contract: no literal model id appears in the suite; expected model ids in assertions are read from catalog.Select(provider, "STANDARD", "")

setup: the catalog's model ids collected from catalog.Select for every provider and tier
check.pseudocode: ids = [catalog.Select(p,t,'').Model.ID for p in providers for t in tiers]; for lit in stringLiterals(files): assert not any(id in lit for id in ids)

criteria.condition: a subtest has not finished within its 30-second context
criteria.action: cancel the run and fail the subtest
criteria.contract: the subtest reports a failure naming the provider and case instead of hanging; other subtests are unaffected

setup: a fake that blocks without replying
the case runner invoked with a 200 ms context deadline and a recording testing.TB stand-in
a second independent subtest using a healthy fake
check.pseudocode: tb = recorder(); start = now(); runCase(tb, 'ollama', textCase, timeout=200ms); assert now()-start < 5s; assert tb.failed and 'ollama' in tb.msg and 'text' in tb.msg

requirements.title: Vendor fakes
requirements.rationale: The providers must be checked against their vendors' wire formats rather than against their own code.

criteria.condition: a request arrives at the vendor endpoint (Anthropic POST /v1/messages, OpenRouter POST /api/v1/chat/completions, Ollama POST /api/chat)
criteria.action: record the request's method, path, headers and body and answer with the next scripted logical turn rendered in that vendor's native wire format, echoing the requested model id
criteria.contract: one scripted turn is consumed per request, in script order

setup: each of the three fakes scripted with two logical turns of different text
check.pseudocode: for f in fakes: r1 = post(f, body1); r2 = post(f, body2); assert f.requests[0].body == body1; assert text(r1)=='A' and text(r2)=='B'; assert model(r1)==requestedModel

criteria.condition: a request arrives at any other path, or after every scripted turn has been consumed
criteria.action: fail the subtest and answer with an HTTP error
criteria.contract: the subtest fails with a message naming the unexpected path or the request number beyond the script

setup: each fake scripted with one turn
a recording testing.TB stand-in
check.pseudocode: post(f,'/v1/other'); assert status>=400 and '/v1/other' in tb.msgs[0]; post(f,valid); post(f,valid); assert status>=400 and 'request 2' in tb.msgs[1]

criteria.action: render text and thinking blocks as two deltas each, tool arguments as two fragments on Anthropic and OpenRouter and whole on Ollama, and usage in the vendor's own fields and netting: Anthropic input net of cache reads, OpenRouter and Ollama prompt totals including cache reads, with a cost reported only by OpenRouter
criteria.contract: text and thinking each arrive as two deltas; tool arguments arrive as two fragments on Anthropic and OpenRouter and as one whole object on Ollama; Anthropic reports input_tokens 40 and cache_read_input_tokens 60; OpenRouter reports prompt_tokens 100 with cached_tokens 60 and cost 0.00042; Ollama reports prompt_eval_count 100 and prompt_eval_cached_count 60 and no cost field

setup: a logical turn with text, thinking and a tool call and usage of 100 prompt tokens, 60 cache reads, 20 output tokens and cost 0.00042
check.pseudocode: body = fake.render(turn); assert count(textDeltas)==2; assert fragments(tool)==(2 if p!='ollama' else 1); assert usageFields(p, body) == expected[p]

criteria.action: render each turn ending in vendor form: the normal stop, the tool-call stop (Anthropic tool_use, OpenRouter tool_calls, Ollama stop), a cut-off body without the final signal (Anthropic message_stop, OpenRouter finish_reason, Ollama done:true), an HTTP error status with the vendor's error body and message, or an in-stream error after the blocks (Anthropic event: error, OpenRouter error chunk with code 502, Ollama {"error":…} line)
criteria.contract: the provider under test receives each ending exactly as its vendor sends it on the wire

setup: each fake and each ending: normal stop, tool-call stop, cut off, HTTP error status, in-stream error
check.pseudocode: for p in providers: for end in endings: raw = fakes[p].render(turnWith(end)); assert matchesVendorForm(p, end, raw)

criteria.condition: a case decodes a recorded request body
criteria.action: return a request summary holding the model id, the effort in vendor form (Anthropic output_config.effort, OpenRouter reasoning.effort, Ollama think), the declared tool names, the user texts, each assistant message's visible text, tool calls (id, name, arguments) and replayed thinking as text and raw vendor form (Anthropic thinking plus signature, OpenRouter reasoning_details, Ollama thinking), and the tool results with their call ids and texts in order
criteria.contract: a Go value comparable across providers

setup: for each vendor a hand-written request body carrying model, effort, one tool echo, a user text, an assistant message with text, a tool call and replayed thinking, and a tool result
check.pseudocode: s = [decode(p, body[p]) for p in providers]; assert s[0].Model==s[1].Model==s[2].Model; assert s[i].Assistant[0].ToolCalls equal; assert s[0].Assistant[0].RawThinking.signature=='sig-conformance'

criteria.action: render and decode with the standard library and encoding/json only, importing no vendor SDK and none of the providers' own test helpers
criteria.contract: the fake source files import no anthropic-sdk-go, OpenRouter SDK or github.com/ollama/ollama package

setup: the fake files of internal/providerconformance parsed with go/parser (ImportsOnly)
check.pseudocode: for f in fakeFiles: for imp in imports(f): assert isStdlib(imp)

requirements.title: Checks common to every case
requirements.rationale: Event order, payloads and request counts are the cross-provider promises the loop relies on.

criteria.action: assert that every recorded request carries the selected row's model id and effort in the vendor's form
criteria.contract: every summary's model equals the selected row's model id; every summary's effort equals the selected effort in the form of output_config.effort, reasoning.effort or think

setup: catalog.Select(provider, "STANDARD", "") for each provider
all seven cases run on all three providers
check.pseudocode: sel = catalog.Select(p,'STANDARD',''); for req in fake.requests: s = decode(req); assert s.Model==sel.Model.ID; assert s.Effort==string(sel.Effort)

criteria.condition: a scripted turn ends with the vendor's normal or tool-call stop
criteria.action: assert that the event skeleton of the turn's provider events equals, type by type and in order, the event skeleton provider/faux emits for the same blocks and stop reason
criteria.contract: the event types of both skeletons are equal in order; TextEndEvent.Text and ThinkingEndEvent.Thinking equal the scripted text; ToolCallEndEvent.Block has the scripted id and name and Input JSON-equal to {"v":"conformance"}

setup: the text, tool_call and thinking cases on each provider
a provider/faux reference provider scripted with the same blocks and stop reason
the three fakes and a generator of logical turns
check.pseudocode:
got = skeleton(providerEvents(events, turn=0)); want = skeleton(collect(faux.New(turn).Stream(ctx, Request{}))); assert types(got)==types(want); assert textEnd.Text==scripted; assert jsonEqual(toolEnd.Block.Input, args)
for turn in gen_turns(): for p in providers: got = skeleton(providerEvents(run(p, turn))); assert types(got)==types(skeleton(faux(turn))); assert payloadsWhole(turn)

criteria.condition: a scripted turn ends with the vendor's normal or tool-call stop
criteria.action: assert that TextEndEvent.Text and ThinkingEndEvent.Thinking hold the full scripted text and that ToolCallEndEvent.Block has the scripted id and name and an Input JSON-equal to the scripted arguments

criteria.condition: a scripted turn fails (cut off, HTTP error status or in-stream error)
criteria.action: assert that the last two provider events are a terminal ErrorEvent followed by a MessageEndEvent whose message has StopReasonError
criteria.contract: the second to last provider event is an ErrorEvent with Terminal true; the last provider event is a MessageEndEvent whose message has StopReasonError

setup: the cut_off, error_status and error_in_stream cases on each provider
check.pseudocode: ev = providerEvents(events, 0); assert ev[-2] is ErrorEvent and ev[-2].Terminal; assert ev[-1] is MessageEndEvent and ev[-1].Message.StopReason==StopReasonError

criteria.condition: the fake records more or fewer requests than the case scripts, for example from an unexpected retry or an extra turn
criteria.action: fail the case
criteria.contract: the failure names the scripted and recorded request counts

setup: a recording testing.TB stand-in
a case scripting 2 turns whose agent finishes after 1 request, and a case scripting 1 turn whose fake sees 2 requests
check.pseudocode: checkCount(tb, scripted=2, recorded=1); assert tb.failed and '2' in tb.msg and '1' in tb.msg; checkCount(tb2, 1, 2); assert tb2.failed

requirements.title: Cases that end normally
requirements.rationale: Text, tool continuation under either stop reason, thinking replay and usage netting must agree across providers.

criteria.condition: the text case runs one turn of "Hello from the conformance suite." ending with the vendor's normal stop
criteria.action: assert StopReasonStop on the message, RunStopEndTurn with a nil error, FinalText equal to the scripted text, and exactly one request carrying the user prompt
criteria.contract: the subtest fails naming the first mismatched field when any assertion does not hold

setup: each provider's fake scripted with the text turn "Hello from the conformance suite." ending with the vendor's normal stop
check.pseudocode: res = run(prompt); assert msg.StopReason==Stop; assert res.StopReason==RunStopEndTurn and res.Error==nil; assert res.FinalText()==text; assert len(reqs)==1 and prompt in decode(reqs[0]).UserTexts

criteria.condition: the text case scripts 100 prompt tokens of which 60 are cache reads, 20 output tokens and, on OpenRouter only, a cost of 0.00042
criteria.action: assert the turn's usage is InputTokens 40, CacheReadTokens 60, OutputTokens 20, ReasoningTokens at most OutputTokens, with the cost bit set and CostUSD equal to the reported cost on OpenRouter and to provider.ComputeCost at the selected row otherwise, and that the run's usage is not flagged unpriced
criteria.contract: InputTokens is 40, CacheReadTokens 60, OutputTokens 20, ReasoningTokens at most OutputTokens; the cost bit is set; CostUSD equals 0.00042 on OpenRouter and provider.ComputeCost(row, usage) on anthropic and ollama; the run's usage is not flagged Unpriced

setup: the text case with 100 prompt tokens of which 60 are cache reads, 20 output tokens and, on OpenRouter only, cost 0.00042
the selected STANDARD row for each provider
check.pseudocode: u = turnEnd.Usage; assert u.InputTokens==40 and u.CacheReadTokens==60 and u.OutputTokens==20 and u.ReasoningTokens<=u.OutputTokens; assert u.Has(UsageCostUSD); assert u.CostUSD == (0.00042 if p=='openrouter' else ComputeCost(&row, u)); assert !res.Usage.Unpriced

criteria.condition: the tool_call case scripts turn 1 as tool call call_conformance_1 to echo with {"v":"conformance"} ending with the vendor's tool-call stop, and turn 2 as text "All done."
criteria.action: assert echo ran once with the scripted arguments, the first request declares echo, the second request carries that call (id, name, arguments) on the assistant message followed by a tool result for call_conformance_1 whose text contains "echoed", and the run ends RunStopEndTurn with a nil error, TurnCount 2 and FinalText "All done."
criteria.contract: the subtest fails naming the first mismatched field when any assertion does not hold

setup: turn 1: tool call call_conformance_1 to echo with {"v":"conformance"} ending with the vendor's tool-call stop (Anthropic tool_use, OpenRouter tool_calls, Ollama stop)
turn 2: text "All done."
check.pseudocode: assert calls.Load()==1; assert 'echo' in decode(reqs[0]).Tools; s = decode(reqs[1]); assert s.Assistant[0].ToolCalls[0]=={id,'echo',args}; assert s.Results[0].CallID=='call_conformance_1' and 'echoed' in s.Results[0].Text; assert res.TurnCount==2

criteria.condition: the tool_call_stop case scripts the tool_call turns with turn 1 ending in the vendor's plain stop (Anthropic end_turn, OpenRouter stop, Ollama stop)
criteria.action: assert the same outcome as the tool_call case
criteria.contract: the loop continues on the tool call whatever the stop reason

setup: the tool_call turns with turn 1 ending in the vendor's plain stop (Anthropic end_turn, OpenRouter stop, Ollama stop)
check.pseudocode: same assertions as tool_call with turn1.end = plainStop[p]

criteria.condition: the thinking case scripts turn 1 as thinking "Plan: call echo once." (signature sig-conformance on Anthropic, two reasoning.text fragments of reasoning_details on OpenRouter) followed by the tool_call call, and turn 2 as text
criteria.action: assert turn 1 emits thinking events, no text event carries any of the thinking, and the first assistant message in the transcript is a ThinkingBlock holding the full thinking followed by the tool use, with no text block containing the thinking
criteria.contract: turn 1 emits ThinkingStart, ThinkingDelta and ThinkingEnd events; no TextStart, TextDelta or TextEnd event contains any part of the thinking; the first assistant message is a ThinkingBlock holding the full thinking followed by the tool use block; no text block of that message contains the thinking

setup: turn 1: thinking "Plan: call echo once." (signature sig-conformance on Anthropic, two reasoning.text fragments on OpenRouter) then the tool_call call
turn 2: text
check.pseudocode: assert any ThinkingEnd in turn1; for e in text events: assert 'Plan' not in e.text; m = res.Messages[1]; assert m.Content[0] is ThinkingBlock and .Thinking==thinking; assert m.Content[1] is ToolUseBlock; assert no TextBlock contains thinking

criteria.condition: the thinking case's second request is decoded
criteria.action: assert the thinking is replayed in raw vendor form exactly as received (Anthropic thinking text and signature sig-conformance, OpenRouter reasoning_details JSON-equal to the sent fragments, Ollama thinking equal to the text) and does not appear in that assistant message's visible content
criteria.contract: Anthropic: thinking text equals the plan and the signature equals sig-conformance; OpenRouter: reasoning_details is JSON-equal to the two fragments sent; Ollama: thinking equals the thinking text; the thinking does not appear in that assistant message's visible content

setup: the thinking case recorded requests on each provider
check.pseudocode: s = decode(reqs[1]).Assistant[0]; switch p: anthropic: assert s.RawThinking=={text, 'sig-conformance'}; openrouter: assert jsonEqual(s.RawThinking, sentFragments); ollama: assert s.RawThinking==text; assert thinking not in s.Text

requirements.title: Cases that fail
requirements.rationale: A cut-off stream, an HTTP error status and an in-stream error are distinct code paths in every provider and must all stop the loop without executing tools.

criteria.condition: the cut_off case scripts text "Partial answer" then a tool call (arguments cut mid-way on Anthropic and OpenRouter, a whole tool-call chunk on Ollama) and ends the body without the final signal
criteria.action: assert the terminal ErrorEvent.Err matches the provider's ErrStreamTruncated by errors.Is and the run ends RunStopError with a non-nil error after exactly one request
criteria.contract: the subtest fails naming the expected and observed error or stop reason when any assertion does not hold

setup: text "Partial answer" then a tool call with arguments cut mid-way (Anthropic, OpenRouter) or a whole tool-call chunk (Ollama), and the body ends without message_stop, finish_reason or done:true
check.pseudocode: assert errors.Is(terminal.Err, truncatedSentinel[p]); assert res.StopReason==RunStopError and res.Error!=nil; assert len(reqs)==1

criteria.condition: the cut_off case has run
criteria.action: assert echo never ran, no ToolExecutionStartEvent was emitted, and the last assistant message has StopReasonError with text containing "Partial answer"
criteria.contract: the assertion holds whether the provider keeps salvaged tool-use blocks in the failed message or drops them

setup: the cut_off case on each provider, whether or not the provider keeps salvaged tool-use blocks
check.pseudocode: assert calls.Load()==0; assert no ToolExecutionStartEvent in events; m = lastAssistant(res.Messages); assert m.StopReason==Error and 'Partial answer' in text(m)

criteria.condition: the error_status case answers HTTP 400 with the vendor's error body and message conformance-bad-request
criteria.action: assert the terminal ErrorEvent.Err is the provider's *StatusError with Code 400 by errors.As, its text starts "<provider>: HTTP 400" and contains conformance-bad-request, the run ends RunStopError, exactly one request was made and no tool ran
criteria.contract: the terminal ErrorEvent.Err is the provider's *StatusError with Code 400 by errors.As; its text starts "<provider>: HTTP 400" and contains conformance-bad-request; the run ends RunStopError; exactly one request was made and the echo tool never ran

setup: each fake answering HTTP 400 with the vendor's error body and message conformance-bad-request
check.pseudocode: var se *pkg.StatusError; assert errors.As(terminal.Err,&se) and se.Code==400; assert hasPrefix(terminal.Message, p+': HTTP 400') and contains(..., 'conformance-bad-request'); assert len(reqs)==1 and calls==0

criteria.condition: the error_in_stream case scripts text "Working on it" then the vendor's in-stream error with message conformance-upstream-failure
criteria.action: assert the terminal ErrorEvent text contains conformance-upstream-failure, the run ends RunStopError, the last assistant message keeps "Working on it", exactly one request was made and no tool ran
criteria.contract: the terminal ErrorEvent text contains conformance-upstream-failure; the run ends RunStopError; the last assistant message keeps "Working on it"; exactly one request was made and no tool ran

setup: text "Working on it" then the vendor's in-stream error with message conformance-upstream-failure
check.pseudocode: assert 'conformance-upstream-failure' in terminal.Err.Error(); assert res.StopReason==RunStopError; assert 'Working on it' in text(lastAssistant); assert len(reqs)==1 and calls==0

requirements.title: Live smoke test gates
requirements.rationale: Developer machines often export keys or run ollama serve, so live tests must need an explicit opt-in as well as each provider's prerequisites.

criteria.condition: TestLive runs under -short
criteria.action: skip the whole test before contacting any service
criteria.contract: the test reports SKIP; make check and plain go test -short make no live request

setup: AGENTKIT_LIVE=1 and OPENROUTER_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_BASE_URL and OLLAMA_HOST pointing at a recording loopback server
check.pseudocode: r = exec('go test -short -v -run TestLive ./internal/providerconformance', env=live+decoy); assert 'SKIP' in r.out and decoy.requests==0

criteria.condition: AGENTKIT_LIVE is not exactly "1"
criteria.action: skip the whole test before contacting any service
criteria.contract: the skip message names AGENTKIT_LIVE and make provider-live-test

setup: no -short flag
a recording loopback server wired through the provider variables
check.pseudocode: for v in [unset,'0','true']: r = exec(go test -v -run TestLive, env); assert 'SKIP' in r.out and 'AGENTKIT_LIVE' in r.out and 'make provider-live-test' in r.out

criteria.condition: anthropic.Resolve(anthropic.OSEnv{}) returns an error in the anthropic subtest
criteria.action: skip the anthropic subtest
criteria.contract: the skip message includes the Resolve error text

setup: AGENTKIT_LIVE=1, no ANTHROPIC_*, Vertex or Bedrock variables in the subprocess environment
check.pseudocode: _, _, err = anthropic.Resolve(OSEnv{}) with empty env; r = exec(...); assert 'SKIP' in r.out['TestLive/anthropic'] and err.Error() in r.out

criteria.condition: OPENROUTER_API_KEY is empty in the openrouter subtest
criteria.action: skip the openrouter subtest
criteria.contract: the skip message names OPENROUTER_API_KEY

setup: AGENTKIT_LIVE=1 and OPENROUTER_API_KEY empty or unset
check.pseudocode: r = exec(env without key); assert 'SKIP' in out and 'OPENROUTER_API_KEY' in out

criteria.condition: in the ollama subtest, ollama.New(row, ollama.Options{}) fails, or GET <Host()>/api/tags with a 2-second timeout is unreachable or answers a non-200 status
criteria.action: skip the ollama subtest
criteria.contract: the skip message names the New error, or the host and ollama serve

setup: AGENTKIT_LIVE=1
three environments: an OLLAMA_HOST that makes ollama.New fail, a closed loopback port, and a loopback server answering /api/tags with 500
check.pseudocode: for env in [badHost, closedPort, status500]: r = exec(...); assert 'SKIP' in r.out; assert ('ollama serve' in r.out and host in r.out) or newErr in r.out

criteria.condition: the ollama /api/tags response does not list the STANDARD tier's model
criteria.action: skip the ollama subtest
criteria.contract: the skip message names ollama pull <model>

setup: AGENTKIT_LIVE=1 and OLLAMA_HOST pointing at a loopback server whose /api/tags lists only another model
check.pseudocode: serve tags {'models':[{'name':'other:1b'}]}; r = exec(...); assert 'ollama pull '+sel.Model.ID in r.out; assert no chat request

criteria.condition: an operator runs make provider-live-test
criteria.action: run AGENTKIT_LIVE=1 go test -count=1 -v -timeout 30m -run TestLive ./internal/providerconformance, a target that neither check nor check-release depends on
criteria.contract: the go test exit status of the live run is the make target's exit status; make check and make check-release never run TestLive

setup: the repository Makefile
check.pseudocode: out = exec('make -n provider-live-test'); assert contains(out, expectedCommand); assert 'provider-live-test' not in transitivePrereqs('check') and not in transitivePrereqs('check-release')

requirements.title: Live smoke test run
requirements.rationale: A real read-a-file-and-answer loop with a random word proves each provider works against its live service within a bounded cost.

criteria.condition: a TestLive subtest's gates and prerequisites are satisfied
criteria.action: write secret.txt holding a fresh random word into a temporary workspace, build the agent with agentkit.New using Provider set to the name, Model "STANDARD", the process environment (no Getenv), only the built-in read_file tool (tools.For then core.Named), MaxTurns 6, MaxCostUSD 0.50 and Timeout 10 minutes, and ask the model to read the file and reply with the word
criteria.contract: the run is bounded at 6 turns, $0.50 and 10 minutes; exceeding a bound ends the run with a non-end-turn stop and the subtest fails

criteria.condition: a live run finishes
criteria.action: assert the run ended RunStopEndTurn with a nil error, at least one read_file call succeeded, and the final text contains the random word
criteria.contract: the subtest fails naming the stop reason, the run error or the missing word when any assertion does not hold

criteria.condition: a live run finishes
criteria.action: assert Agent.Resolution() reports the provider name, tier STANDARD, and the model id and effort that catalog.Select gives
criteria.contract: Resolution reports the provider name, tier STANDARD and the model id and effort catalog.Select gives; input and output tokens are positive; the run's usage is not flagged Unpriced; cost is positive on anthropic and openrouter and exactly zero on ollama; model, effort, turns, tokens and cost are logged with t.Logf

setup: AGENTKIT_LIVE=1, a ready provider, and a finished live run
check.pseudocode: r = agent.Resolution(); sel = catalog.Select(p,'STANDARD',''); assert r.Provider==p and r.Tier==STANDARD and r.Model.ID==sel.Model.ID and r.Effort==sel.Effort; u = res.Usage; assert u.InputTokens>0 and u.OutputTokens>0 and !u.Unpriced; assert (u.CostUSD>0) == (p!='ollama'); t.Logf(...)

criteria.condition: a live run finishes
criteria.action: assert input and output tokens are positive, the run's usage is not flagged unpriced, and the cost is positive on anthropic and openrouter and zero on ollama, then log the model, effort, turns, tokens and cost

requirements.title: Examples choose provider, model and effort
requirements.rationale: The model-calling examples should select what runs a model the same way an embedder does.

criteria.action: read AGENTKIT_PROVIDER, AGENTKIT_MODEL and AGENTKIT_EFFORT from the process environment with their own few lines (no shared helper) and pass them unchanged to agentkit.Config Provider, Model and Effort, with defaults empty, "STANDARD" and empty
criteria.contract: each file reads AGENTKIT_PROVIDER, AGENTKIT_MODEL and AGENTKIT_EFFORT from the process environment; AGENTKIT_MODEL defaults to "STANDARD", the other two to empty; the values reach Config.Provider, Config.Model and Config.Effort with no other transformation; no example imports a shared helper package for this

setup: the main.go of examples/codingagent, examples/customtools and examples/mcp parsed with go/parser
an Ollama-shaped server answering one text turn
subprocess environment with AGENTKIT_PROVIDER=ollama and OLLAMA_HOST only, AGENTKIT_MODEL and AGENTKIT_EFFORT unset
check.pseudocode:
for ex in examples: assert getenvNames(ex) ⊇ {PROVIDER, MODEL, EFFORT}; assert defaultOf(MODEL)=='STANDARD'; assert Config literal fields Provider, Model, Effort set from those
for ex in examples: out = run(ex, {AGENTKIT_PROVIDER:'ollama', OLLAMA_HOST:srv.URL}); sel = catalog.Select('ollama','STANDARD',''); assert req.model==sel.Model.ID and req.think==string(sel.Effort); assert summary contains provider, model, effort

criteria.action: not call catalog.Lookup or anthropic.Resolve and not import anthropic-sdk-go
